title: Credential Reference
description: A reference to a credential by identity and availability -- never the credential value. A descriptor or plugin declares which credential references it needs; the facade resolves availability and refuses the call when a required reference is missing. The value itself is injected only into the owned child environment and is never persisted in a descriptor, receipt or evidence record.

source.description: Where the value is resolved from (e.g. inherited_environment, consumer_secret_store). Opaque to the facade.

availability.description: Observed availability at admission time. 'missing' is a first-class, reportable state -- it is not simulated as success.

injection.description: How the value reaches the adapter. Only an owned child environment is admissible.

persistent_values.description: A reference never persists a value. This must be false; a truthy value is refused. A 'value', 'secret', 'token', 'cookie_value' or 'api_key' field is an additional property and fails closed, so no credential value can ride along in a reference.
